headlines.text: Looking back to 2021, when Thunder Rosa vs. Britt Baker settled things in a Lights Out match, closing out the card as the main event on Dynamite, rated 8.66 ? a match fans still talk about in a standout Women's division showcase ? part of that year's St Patrick Day's Slam '21. A historic night ? the first-ever women's match to main event AEW Dynamite, and it delivered fully on the occasion: a bloody, brutal Lights Out brawl with thumbtacks, tables, and a ladder, capping the best women's feud AEW had produced to that point.
On this day in 2023, Harv Sihra made their first appearance under the AEW banner, appearing on Rampage, rated 4.26.
It was 2021 when after 3 matches, Luke Gallows debuted a bold new identity: Doc Gallows, on Dynamite.

secondaries.text: On this day in 2023, the AEW TNT Title was up for grabs as Powerhouse Hobbs vs. Rey Fenix went to war, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.27 ? a match that delivered.
Rewind to 2021, when Rey Fenix vs. Angelico locked horns for the first time on Dynamite, rated 5.72.
Turning the clock back to 2021: Cody Rhodes vs. Penta El Zero M locked horns for the first time, kicking off the show on Dynamite, rated 6.11.
